data.narrative:
New Limit is a Series C-stage biotech & health company founded by Brian Armstrong, Blake Byers, and Jacob Kimmel, currently valued at $3.1B post-money following $610M+ in total capital raised. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 11 private peers (including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals) and 3 public biotech companies (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L).

Two triangulation methods prove applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a typical 1.7x Series C step-up multiplier to the $3.1B last post-money valuation, implying $5.3B. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies yields $3.8B, with the comp set ranging from $539M (Eikon Therapeutics, Series B) to $10.3B (Colossal Biosciences, Series C). Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied due to the absence of revenue disclosure. These two methods triangulate to a valuation range of $3.2B (low) to $6.1B (high), with a median of $4.5B. The current $3.1B valuation sits below this range, reflecting typical Series C post-money pricing discipline. Key uncertainty centers on stage-progression assumptions and peer comparability; the wide dispersion within the peer set ($539M–$10.3B) reflects heterogeneity in business model and maturity within frontier biotech.
